problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 8 delivery trucks to unload at 8 different warehouse docks.

Each truck has a predetermined unloading sequence represented as (Dock, Unloading time) pairs, where each pair specifies the dock where the unloading must occur and the time required. The sequence of pairs indicates the strict order in which the unloading steps must be performed.

Truck details:
* Truck 1 must follow the sequence: (Dock 2, 5) → (Dock 4, 3) → (Dock 3, 3) → (Dock 6, 9) → (Dock 5, 3) → (Dock 8, 8) → (Dock 1, 4) → (Dock 7, 2)
* Truck 2 must follow the sequence: (Dock 5, 8) → (Dock 6, 8) → (Dock 1, 3) → (Dock 7, 3) → (Dock 4, 1) → (Dock 3, 2) → (Dock 8, 3) → (Dock 2, 2)
* Truck 3 must follow the sequence: (Dock 7, 5) → (Dock 5, 7) → (Dock 1, 3) → (Dock 3, 9) → (Dock 6, 8) → (Dock 8, 5) → (Dock 4, 6) → (Dock 2, 3)
* Truck 4 must follow the sequence: (Dock 7, 2) → (Dock 3, 6) → (Dock 2, 9) → (Dock 6, 7) → (Dock 1, 5) → (Dock 4, 8) → (Dock 5, 1) → (Dock 8, 3)
* Truck 5 must follow the sequence: (Dock 6, 7) → (Dock 2, 2) → (Dock 4, 6) → (Dock 7, 4) → (Dock 5, 2) → (Dock 1, 6) → (Dock 3, 3) → (Dock 8, 4)
* Truck 6 must follow the sequence: (Dock 4, 5) → (Dock 5, 1) → (Dock 7, 10) → (Dock 3, 10) → (Dock 8, 3) → (Dock 2, 5) → (Dock 6, 4) → (Dock 1, 9)
* Truck 7 must follow the sequence: (Dock 2, 7) → (Dock 3, 6) → (Dock 4, 10) → (Dock 8, 6) → (Dock 1, 4) → (Dock 6, 6) → (Dock 5, 8) → (Dock 7, 3)
* Truck 8 must follow the sequence: (Dock 1, 2) → (Dock 6, 1) → (Dock 4, 6) → (Dock 2, 5) → (Dock 8, 4) → (Dock 7, 2) → (Dock 3, 1) → (Dock 5, 4)

Each unloading operation must proceed without interruption once it begins, and each dock can only accommodate one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all unloading operations at the docks so that the total time to complete all truck unloadings is minimized.
